label: IGH / CCND3

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
CCND3 encodes cyclin D3, a regulator of CDK4/6-dependent cell-cycle progression.

Immunoglobulin enhancer juxtaposition increases CCND3 expression and can substitute for cyclin D1 activation in a subset of cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphomas. These events require an appropriate mantle-cell morphologic and phenotypic classification.
